---
name: Feature request
about: Propose a new feature or enhancement
title: '[Feature] '
labels: enhancement
---

## Problem
What are you trying to do that's hard or impossible today?

## Proposed solution
What would an ideal fix look like? Code sketches, API mockups, UX flows — anything concrete helps.

## Alternatives considered
Did you try working around this? What didn't work?

## Scope & impact
- Who benefits from this change? (individual users / ops / skill authors / ...)
- Does it change an existing public API?
- Does it affect security posture? (Consider SECURITY.md threat model)
